name: Aritmètica i càlcul
prototypes: basic arithmetic word problem: add, subtract, multiply or divide quantities to find a total
how many are left, how much does it cost in total, sharing things equally among people
value of a numerical expression, order of operations, sums and products of numbers

name: Nombres i divisibilitat
prototypes: digits of a number, divisibility, multiples, divisors, prime numbers, remainders
even and odd numbers, the largest or smallest number with a property, sum of the digits

name: Fraccions i proporcions
prototypes: fractions of a quantity, percentages, ratios and proportions
what fraction of the figure is shaded, half, a third, a quarter of the total, percent increase

name: Àlgebra i equacions
prototypes: equation with an unknown number, solve for x, expressions with variables
ages of people now and in some years, a number such that twice the number plus another equals

name: Patrons i successions
prototypes: number sequence, what is the next term, the 100th term, repeating pattern
a pattern of shapes that continues in the same way, which figure comes next

name: Geometria plana
prototypes: area and perimeter of rectangles, squares, triangles and circles
angles in a triangle, lengths of sides, parallel lines, a shape cut into pieces

name: Geometria de l'espai
prototypes: cubes, faces, edges and vertices of a solid, building made of small cubes
net of a cube, folding paper, views of a 3D object from the front and from above, dice

name: Recompte i combinatòria
prototypes: counting arrangements, in how many different ways, combinations and permutations
how many different paths, how many possible outfits, how many handshakes, choosing items

name: Lògica i deducció
prototypes: logical deduction, true and false statements, who is lying, exactly one of them tells the truth
ordering people from clues, who sits next to whom, which statement must be true, a balance puzzle

name: Mesura, temps i unitats
prototypes: time, clocks, hours and minutes, days of the week, calendar dates
speed and distance, weights, lengths in metres and centimetres, litres, converting units
